issues.desc: CHK-003 selfcheck specifies oracle purity via chdir-independence (two invocations byte-identical under chdir). This test confirms determinism under path change but does not mechanically prevent reads outside the fixture dir — it relies on convention, not sandboxing, matching the recovery-runner ground-truth.mjs pattern. No action required; the plan does not mandate sandboxing, but the description should not imply chdir-independence proves external-read absence.

CHK-003 introduces reference-bad/ and reference-good/ as subdirectories inside the fixture dir (outside workspace/). This is a net-new pattern not directly inherited from recovery-runner, which uses reference-solution.mjs and subtle-wrong-output.mjs as flat files. The design is valid for binary oracle testing but the checklist presents it as a structural continuation of the recovery-runner precedent without calling out this divergence.
